0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road, 3-7 in their last ten) come in 9th in the East on a one-game winning streak, while the Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home, 3-5 in their last ten) sit 12th in the West after winning their last two. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Charlotte won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, with no games yet played between them this season. Charlotte will be without Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, all out, while Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate are day-to-day with game-time decisions; Phoenix is missing Mark Williams, who is out.
